latent_serialization: per-window full 32-D EMA latent plus 16-D semantic and 16-D execution slices, with checkpoint/episode/frame provenance
temporal_indexing: H=16 action window at t encodes actions [t,t+15]; next latent uses the next causal window definition frozen before dynamics execution
causal_information_set: future target-window actions forbidden as generalized force when predicting the latent encoded from those actions
oracle_teacher_forced_diagnostic: optional and reported separately; never a causal baseline
metrics: decoded-action continuous MSE and gripper accuracy
